info.title: BornRok Alpha
info.author: HereWolfyx
info.details:
Here we go guys: the first Alpha 0.37.0 release is OUT! 

Only MMO mode on the play.bornrok.com server. Expect low performance (specially in prontera). 
Read controls in settings to understand how does it works and follow the guide to create a Character. 

This is an alpha release for first testing. 
Follow update on the Homebrew here: 
 - https://ko-fi.com/herewolfyx
 - https://www.youtube.com/@HereWolfyx

if you want to support my work from Ko-fi or paypal.me/erikdascoli


In the future i'll implement offline gaming with Population Engine.

changelog:
- First alpha Release:
Added game patcher and checker when you install it first time
Native gamepad support
Only one server avaiable (play.bornrok.com)
